description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mabodala, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510401
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title classifications, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
